B tells the user that changes save automatically and shows every sleep-timer option as a segmented control, while A shows no save feedback and puts the sleep timer in a select. Text size and reset are below the fold in both screenshots, so items 3–4 are scored on limited evidence, partly from the visible grouping. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two answers look much alike: dark cards, sensible defaults, and grouping that puts the most-changed settings first.
